blocks.text: What you wear versus what you watch on TV. Life does imitate art and vice versa, but which follows which when it comes to fashion and streaming? Quite often, costume designers and stylists working on a show often borrow from the streets to visualize the cultural mood of the moment. On the other hand, audiences absorb these looks and bring it back into the real world. Ever since Giorgio Armani made cinema elegant and costume designer Patricia Field influenced global trends with every season of the HBO Original series Sex and the City, fashion on-screen has done more than expound a […]...
